+    # 2-opt local search

+    while time.process_time() < time_limit * 1.5:
+        best_improvement = 0.0

+        
+        # O(N^2) search, but bounded by time
+        for i in range(n - 2):
+            for j in range(i + 1, n - 1):
+                # Indices for 2-opt swap: (i-1, i) and (j, j+1)
+                
+                p_prev_idx = current_tour[(i - 1) % n]
+                p_i_idx = current_tour[i]
+                p_j_idx = current_tour[j]
+                p_next_idx = current_tour[(j + 1) % n]
+                
+                p_prev = points[p_prev_idx]
+                p_i = points[p_i_idx]
+                p_j = points[p_j_idx]
+                p_next = points[p_next_idx]
+                
+                # Old distance = d(p_prev, p_i) + d(p_j, p_next)
+                old_dist = math.hypot(p_prev[0] - p_i[0], p_prev[1] - p_i[1]) + \
+                           math.hypot(p_j[0] - p_next[0], p_j[1] - p_next[1])
+                
+                # New distance = d(p_prev, p_j) + d(p_i, p_next)
+                new_dist = math.hypot(p_prev[0] - p_j[0], p_prev[1] - p_j[1]) + \
+                           math.hypot(p_i[0] - p_next[0], p_i[1] - p_next[1])
+                
+                improvement = old_dist - new_dist
+                
+                if improvement > best_improvement:
+                    best_improvement = improvement
+                    best_i = i
+                    best_j = j
+
+        if best_improvement > 0:
+            i, j = best_i, best_j
+            
+            # Reverse segment tour[i:j+1]
+            new_tour = current_tour[:i] + current_tour[i:j+1][::-1] + current_tour[j+1:]
+            current_tour = new_tour
+        else:
